replacement: “Not a bit of it! He claims it as a merit for himself and his Church that they have at last conquered freedom, and done it to make men happy. ‘For now’ (he means the Inquisition, of course) ‘for the first time, it has become possible to think about men’s happiness. Man was made a rebel, and how can rebels be happy? You were warned,’ he tells Him. ‘You had no lack of admonitions and warnings, but You did not heed them. You rejected the one way by which men could be made happy. But luckily, when You left, You passed the work on to us. You promised it, You confirmed it by Your word, You gave us the right to bind and to unbind. So of course You cannot now think of taking it away. Why, then, have You come to stand in our way?’”
